evidence.native: Pinned native ExplosionInfo +96, ProjectileInfo +236, and component members typed FireTemplate; exact explosion names and parent-source graph are re-derived from the pinned SDK and data library.
evidence.area_duration_basis: Per-event cited community field reports are bounded heuristics, not verified native area-instance lifetimes; equal FireTemplate values do not prove equal durations.

conservative_area_window.basis: For uniquely named native player explosion parents with no reviewed pool lifetime, a5-second association rule limits inference. It does not replace or assert the actual fuel lifetime.

evidence.area_radius_basis: Each native explosion outer radius bounds association; it is not a measured ground-fire footprint. Shockwave radius is not substituted.
evidence.victim_status: Native victim fire status3s is distinct from ground-area duration. Health extension kind/element is reliable only at owned life2, never for live HP loss.
evidence.requirements: Exact observed local detonation, actual owned target death life2 with native kind2 element1, target position, local creditor or existing native local-kill quota. Direct known sources always win.
evidence.shared_family_exception: MD-I4 retains shared/unresolved native origin flags. Its exact event additionally requires a native source_type or owner_type in required_event_types; these types are not installed as global weapon aliases.
evidence.unverified_templates: The pinned Filediver enum names values1..4. Value5 is named Count there, yet2 explosion rows store it; these are inventoried but not automatically attributed.

limitations: Configured references prove capability, not activation or a particular player kill.
No live process is read and no game API is called by this generator.
An unavailable/remote explosion event cannot create a local area context.
Native defaults may be changed by other MODs; cited durations may vary.

Spray weapons, drones, flame sentries, vehicle flamers, unowned projectiles and code-created ground effects remain inventoried gaps until a real creation/impact event and bounded lifetime are established.
Enemy/environment templates and unsupported template5 are never promoted into player weapon areas.
